Agent Name: BusinessLogic_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the business logic by counting even-numbered street addresses for the sunset design without considering that the awnings are installed on the back of the houses. Given odd-numbered houses face east in front (thus their backs face west), odd-numbered addresses should receive the sunset design. Overlooking this front/back orientation flip led to the incorrect count of 4 instead of the correct 8.
